:knowledge-point/questions.:question/problem: At an arcade, players collect prize tickets that have different point values based on their color. One player won $R$ red tickets and $B$ blue tickets worth a total of $1,300$ points. The equation $75R + 90B = 1,300$ represents this situation. How many more points is a blue ticket worth than a red ticket?

:topic/_knowledge-points.:topic/title: Interpreting Coefficients of Two-Variable Linear Equations
